verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for a SaaS design product, but the evidence pack never mentions API keys, tokens, or any least-privilege credential mechanism for agents. Collaborator edit access and org-scoped share links are adjacent sharing controls, not API credentials, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
